description_expanded: AboutNew Rental | New Build | Professionally Decorated Coastal Opulence – A Luxurious 30A Vacation Rental Seagrove Beach | 7 Bedrooms | 6.5 Bathrooms | Sleeps 14 | Private Pool, Hot Tub, Game Room, Elevator Why Guests Love Coastal Opulence • Private Pool and Hot Tub – A secluded outdoor oasis perfect for relaxing • Prime Seagrove Beach Location – Close to multiple public beach access points • Elevator • Spacious Open-Concept Living – Ideal for entertaining and gathering with loved ones - Two living rooms! • Gourmet Kitchen – High-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and a large island • Professionally Designed Interiors – Modern coastal décor with luxury finishes • Multiple Outdoor Spaces – Covered patios, balconies, outdoor TV, and a grilling area for outdoor dining • Game Room with Pool Table – A second living space for entertainment • Bunk Room for Kids – Comfortable and fun retreat designed for younger guests • Beach Essentials Included – Backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella • Smart TVs and Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected and entertained • Two sets of washers and dryers • Golf Cart - Add a Street Legal Golf Cart and Receive a 10% Discount off the Golf Cart Rental Rate • Starter Amenity Package – Includes Starbucks coffee, bottled water, toiletries, and cleaning essentials Your Ultimate Seagrove Beach Getaway Starts Here Welcome to Coastal Opulence, a newly built luxury 30A vacation rental ideally located in the heart of Seagrove Beach. This expansive 7-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom beach house sleeps up to 14 guests and offers resort-style amenities, stylish interiors, and a prime location just minutes from the white-sand beaches of 30A. Whether you're planning a family beach vacation, multi-family gathering, or a friends’ getaway, this professionally decorated home delivers the perfect mix of modern luxury and relaxed coastal charm. Inside, you’ll find an open-concept living area with soaring ceilings, natural light, and elegant finishes. The chef’s kitchen is fully stocked and features premium appliances, a large island, and ample seating for dining or entertaining. Relax in Style and Comfort Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed for privacy and comfort, with plush bedding, spacious layouts, and en-suite bathrooms. • Top-Floor King Suites – One suite features a spa-inspired bathroom with soaking tub and walk-in shower • Second-Floor King Bedroom – Steps from the main living space for convenience • First-Floor Bedrooms – Two additional king suites plus a cozy bunk room with twin-over-twin bunks • Game Room & Kitchenette – A separate entertainment space with pool table, Smart TV, and wet bar Outdoor Bliss and 30A Adventures Await Unwind in the private backyard featuring a heated pool and hot tub, or take your morning coffee on the covered balcony. Grill up dinner under the stars or explore the area on bikes or with a golf cart rental for easy beach access and cruising along Scenic Highway 30A. Situated just minutes from Seaside, WaterColor, and other popular 30A beach communities, you'll be close to dining, shopping, and nature trails while enjoying peace and privacy at home. Book Your 30A Dream Vacation Today This Seagrove Beach vacation rental offers everything you need for a luxurious, memorable getaway. Availability is limited — reserve your stay at Coastal Opulence today and discover the best of 30A living.
